title: NEXY autonomous round 6 — UI backend-truth fail-closed state/action gating
scope: DOC-C §16.1/§16.5 UI truth contract and blocking-action state gating
inputs_summary: Canonical SystemEnvelope/state contracts, health readiness handler, current SystemStateProvider and directive/recovery UI surfaces.
actions: Proved frontend initialized READY without backend evidence, read nested data.state although canonical SystemEnvelope state is top-level, omitted canonical states INIT/VERIFYING/CONSENSUS, and silently retained false READY on health failure.
Added exact canonical state parser and nullable truth state with LOADING/READY/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE readiness.
Changed health fetch to /api/health/readiness and fail-closed null state on in-flight/missing/malformed/network failure.
Made UNKNOWN state visible globally and expanded state badge/status descriptions to canonical set.
Locked directive dispatch until backend readiness confirms current state and locked FREEZE/STOP.
Rendered recovery mutation form only when canonical backend state is FREEZE.
Added exact UI truth/action static contract tests and ran full current CI.

claims_proofs.claim: Pre-R6 UI could fabricate READY and mask backend unavailability.
claims_proofs.proof: Provider default/useState READY; fetch /api/health; read data.data.state; catch silently ignored errors.

claims_proofs.claim: R6 UI now treats unknown/in-flight/failed health as unavailable rather than a canonical state.
claims_proofs.proof: Provider state is VNextState|null, parser accepts only canonical top-level envelope state, catch sets null/UNAVAILABLE, global UNKNOWN banner.

claims_proofs.claim: Blocking UI actions are gated on confirmed backend truth.
claims_proofs.proof: Directive form disabled when state null/readiness not READY/FREEZE/STOP; recovery modal rendered only for confirmed FREEZE.

claims_proofs.claim: R6 is regression-clean at tested SHA.
claims_proofs.proof: Workflow 35553622340 all validation gates passed; deploy skipped.

successes: Locked directive/recovery surfaces when backend truth is absent/incompatible.
decisions: Unknown/unreachable health is represented as no canonical state, never mapped to READY/FREEZE.
Recovery is permitted to render only from confirmed FREEZE; OWNER/recoverable presentation remains a separate evidence/wiring concern.
unresolved: No proven Next HTTP binding exists for frontend /api/* requests.
UI OWNER/recoverable-specific recovery presentation remains unresolved.
Browser-level UI critical-flow E2E gate remains absent.
risks: Fail-closed UI now correctly locks if route wiring is absent; this exposes rather than masks transport gap.
limits: R6 does not claim API route wiring or browser E2E.
rollback: Revert a2137eca5d891fb2f9c5c2f3f16bc5f9eaf3262e and 169baec543638631d879bf4454c008bac87dede8 only if authoritative DOC-C §16 changes.
next_actions: Repair/implement verified frontend API transport wiring.
Then add browser E2E for critical UI flows.
